content: Original dingmaotu/mql-zmq (binds ZeroMQ 4.2 for MQL4/5) has compile errors on modern MQL5 builds - community forks exist to fix this (coke5151/mql5-zmq, ding9736/MQL5-ZeroMQ which wraps libzmq.dll directly and claims feature-complete high-performance messaging). Original repo appears stale; forks are the practical choice if going the socket route.
